# When should an AI join a group conversation? A When2Speak diagnostic

Group-chat assistants must balance useful contributions against unnecessary interruptions. We evaluated two simple rules and a local model using a public synthetic benchmark.

![Study overview](/assets/research/h30-cover.svg)

## Scope

[PITCH](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25896) reports 1,091 human timing judgments across 35 actual conversations, and best-turn accuracy of 57.8% with full history versus 19.0% in live decisions. We did not reproduce PITCH. [Boba terms](https://boba.app/terms), updated October 21, 2026, restrict competitive testing and competing-model training in sections 9(21) and 9(22). No Boba service interaction or outputs were collected.

[When2Speak](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05626) provides [CC BY 4.0 synthetic conversations](https://huggingface.co/datasets/duke-trust-lab/When2Speak), generated from topics grounded in Yahoo Answers. Its card reports 216,800 decision pairs from 16,000 conversations. We downloaded the token test set at revision 092e40995896b0c278a1e32954297ef125b70112 and recorded its SHA-256. It contains 21,687 decisions, 2,795 SPEAK and 18,892 SILENT. This is not a direct measurement of human intervention preferences.

## Full test rules

We excluded the final label from inputs. The name-marker rule speaks only if the current utterance contains [AGENT]. Always silent obtains 87.11% accuracy but misses every positive. The marker rule yields TP395, FP575, FN2400, TN18317, accuracy86.28%, recall14.13%, FPR3.04%, F1 .209827. A mention is not necessarily an invitation.

![Full-test metrics](/assets/research/h30-full.svg)

## Local model

With seed30 we sampled 24 distinct prefixes per class, at most 3,000 characters each. Conversation-level independence is not established. Local Qwen2.5:1.5b received the same prefix, JSON Schema constrained SPEAK/SILENT, temperature zero, 24 maximum generated tokens and context2048. Context truncation was not audited. Always silent and the marker rule each reached 50% accuracy on this balanced sample. The local model spoke only once, a false positive: TP0, FP1, FN24, TN23, accuracy47.92%, F1 zero. All outputs were valid. It did not beat the baselines.

![Balanced-sample confusion matrix](/assets/research/h30-local.svg)

A same-machine replay matched every recorded field except elapsed time, for 96 total local calls. Five tests passed in normal and optimized Python. The downloaded test file was deleted. No new paid API, model training, external messages or actual interventions occurred.

## Implications

Accuracy alone can reward silence, while maximizing recall alone can reward interruption. Evaluate precision, recall, false-positive rate, timing, consent and user benefit separately. Predicted utility must never override consent. The current diagnostic does not justify deployment. Independent consenting adult conversations, human acceptable-time windows and privacy/revocation validation remain in [issue #861](https://github.com/Daisuke134/anicca-ops/issues/861). No Manager weights or production app changed.
